title: No-answer -> callback + door-knock task (no SMS)
goal: When an outbound dial gets NO ANSWER (no live conversation, so no consent), create a callback/door-knock task for the rep instead of texting. Keeps non-pickups worked hard while staying off the cold-text path.
why: A no-answer = no conversation = no consent. The Command list is a scraped Wichita auto-shop CSV with no opt-in trail and some landlines, so texting non-pickups is a cold SMS blast: $500-$1,500/msg TCPA exposure, a 10DLC violation, and carrier/A2P review risk that can reach the AT&T dealership. Non-pickups route to CALL/DOOR, never SMS.

deployment.status: draft — NOT published. Add the trigger in the UI (see triggerSetup), confirm the assignee, then publish.

triggerSetup.note: The connector writes workflow ACTIONS but does NOT persist workflow TRIGGERS. Add the trigger manually in the GHL UI.
uiSteps: Open Automation > No-Answer — Callback + Door Task.
Add Trigger > 'Call Status'. Set Status = No Answer (optionally add Busy and Failed), Direction = Outgoing.
Alternative: if Wavv stamps a disposition tag, use Trigger = 'Contact Tag' with tag added = wavv-no-answer. Pick whichever the dialer actually fires.
Confirm the 'Callback + door task' action's Assign To points to the rep working the list (default is contact owner).
Optional: add 'Add Tag' = needs-callback, and 'Move Opportunity' to a Call Back stage.

steps.description: Create a re-dial / door-knock task on the contact. Note explicitly says do NOT text.

attributes.title: Call back / door-knock — no answer
attributes.body: No answer on the dial. Re-dial {{contact.phone}} and, if clean & non-DNC, route to door-knock. {{contact.first_name}} — {{contact.address1}}. Do NOT text (no consent).

repWorkflow: Non-pickups land in the Tasks list (and the needs-callback smart list if the tag is added). Reps re-dial; the clean, non-DNC ones go to door-knock. No SMS at any point.

compliance.noSms: This branch never sends SMS. Texting is reserved for contacts the team spoke to live (answered call) or who opted in.
compliance.consentUnlock: To make non-pickups textable the right way, stand up an opt-in (text-keyword e.g. FIBER to 832-247-4060, or a QR/short link on the flyer). Opt-ins are consented and textable going forward.
compliance.dnc: Door/call only on clean, non-DNC numbers. Honor DNC flags.

output: Every outbound no-answer becomes a callback/door task for a rep — non-pickups worked aggressively with zero cold-text exposure.
